title: The Hermit's burden
summary: Why Hermits are the outcasts of the hunt.

claims.text: Hermits feel bound to act in the hunt, yet acting brings painful confrontation and holding back brings tormenting otherworldly commands, so they suffer either way.
Other hunters often write Hermits off as insane or freakish and avoid working with them until times grow desperate.
Now and then a Hermit is seized by a sweeping truth about monsters, the imbued or the Heralds and has no choice but to share it, which makes the outcasts valuable to hunters at large.
Each Hermit tends to coin a private vocabulary for monsters, hunters and the mission, built from Messenger contact and rare meetings with other imbued.
